questions.question: Test pyramid — Unit, Integration, E2E tests tỷ lệ như thế nào?

options.A: E2E tests là quan trọng nhất
options.B: Unit (70%): fast, cheap, isolated. Integration (20%): test component interaction. E2E (10%): slow, expensive, flaky. Tháp: base rộng là unit
options.D: E2E tests thay thế unit tests

questions.explanation: Test pyramid (Mike Cohn): Unit (base) → Integration (middle) → E2E (top). Unit: test 1 function/class in isolation, mock dependencies, ms speed, cheap to run. Integration: test components together (API + DB, external services). E2E: test entire flow từ user perspective (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress). Ice cream anti-pattern: đảo ngược pyramid (nhiều E2E, ít unit) → slow, flaky, expensive CI. Testing trophy (Kent C. Dodds): integration tests trọng tâm hơn unit.

questions.question: TDD (Test-Driven Development) — Red-Green-Refactor cycle?

options.A: TDD: viết test sau khi code xong
options.B: Red: write failing test. Green: write minimal code to pass. Refactor: improve code while tests pass. TDD design = testable code
options.D: TDD làm code chậm hơn và không cần thiết

questions.explanation: TDD cycle: (1) Red: write a failing test (test không pass vì code chưa tồn tại). (2) Green: write MINIMAL code to make test pass. (3) Refactor: clean up code, tests still pass. Benefits: forces design thinking, living documentation, confidence to refactor, fewer bugs. Challenges: takes discipline, need fast test suite, learning curve. BDD (Behavior-Driven Development): Given-When-Then syntax, Gherkin, collaboration tool (Cucumber, Behave). ATDD: Acceptance Test-Driven Development.

questions.question: Test doubles — Mock, Stub, Spy, Fake, Dummy khác nhau thế nào?

options.A: Tất cả giống nhau, chỉ tên khác
options.B: Dummy: placeholder. Stub: canned responses. Fake: working implementation (in-memory DB). Spy: record calls. Mock: verify interactions
options.C: Mock là tên chung cho tất cả

questions.explanation: Test doubles (Gerard Meszaros): Dummy: passed but never used (fill params). Stub: return hardcoded responses (when repository.findById(1) thenReturn user). Spy: like stub but records calls (verify() trong Mockito). Mock: pre-programmed với expectations, verify behavior. Fake: actual working implementation but simplified (H2 in-memory DB thay PostgreSQL, fake email server). Common confusion: 'mocking' thường dùng để nói chung test doubles. Mockito (Java), unittest.mock (Python), Jest (JS): frameworks để tạo test doubles.

questions.question: Code coverage — metrics và pitfalls?

options.B: Coverage metrics: line, branch, function. Coverage là necessary nhưng không sufficient — test quality quan trọng hơn quantity. Mutation testing để check quality
options.D: Coverage không cần thiết với TDD

questions.explanation: Coverage types: Line coverage (% lines executed), Branch coverage (% if/else branches), Function coverage. Pitfalls: (1) Test quality: test passes nhưng không assert gì (100% coverage, 0 value). (2) Coverage không đo missing cases. (3) Gaming metrics: write tests chỉ để tăng số. Mutation testing (PIT, Stryker): tự động thay đổi code (mutant) → nếu test không fail → test yếu. Good coverage: 80%+ nhưng focus on critical paths. Don't pursue 100% (diminishing returns, test brittle infrastructure code).

questions.question: API Testing với Postman và automation?

options.B: Postman: collections, environments, pre-request scripts, test scripts. Newman: CLI runner cho CI/CD. REST Assured (Java), SuperTest (Node) cho automation

questions.explanation: Postman: create requests, collections (group related). Environment variables: {{base_url}}, {{token}}. Pre-request script: generate auth token. Test scripts (JavaScript): pm.test('Status 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.expect(responseJson.data.id).to.be.a('number'). Data-driven: CSV/JSON data files for parameterized tests. Newman: newman run collection.json --environment prod.json — chạy trong CI. Mock servers: Postman mock cho development. Contract testing: Pact — consumer-driven contract.

questions.question: E2E testing với Playwright — setup và best practices?

options.A: Selenium là tốt nhất cho E2E
options.B: Playwright: multi-browser (Chrome/Firefox/Safari), auto-wait, screenshot/video on fail, network intercept. Page Object Model cho maintainability

questions.explanation: Playwright setup: npm init playwright. Test: test('login flow', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('/login'); await page.fill('#email', 'user@test.com'); await page.fill('#password', 'password'); await page.click('button[type=submit]'); await expect(page).toHaveURL('/dashboard'); }). Auto-wait: Playwright tự chờ element visible, không cần explicit waits. Page Object Model: class LoginPage { async login(email, pass) {...} }. Screenshot on fail: attachments. Trace viewer: full debug info. API mocking: await page.route('**/api/users', route => route.fulfill({body:...})). vs Cypress: Playwright multi-tab, cross-browser, faster CI.

questions.question: Flaky tests trong CI — systematic approach để fix?

options.B: Identify root cause: async timing, shared state, external dependencies, order dependency. Fix: proper await, test isolation, mock externals, deterministic data

questions.explanation: Flaky test causes: (1) Async timing: không await properly, race conditions. Fix: explicit await, wait for element/condition. (2) Shared state: test A modifies data, Test B assumes clean state. Fix: beforeEach cleanup, test-specific data. (3) External dependencies: network, file system, time. Fix: mock/stub externals, deterministic fixtures. (4) Test order dependency: test passes only when run after another. Fix: each test must be independent. (5) Flaky E2E: animation, dynamic content. Fix: disable animations in test env, wait for specific element. Track: flakiness rate per test, quarantine + fix.

questions.question: Performance testing với k6 — load test API trước release?

options.B: k6: virtual users, ramp-up/sustained/ramp-down phases, thresholds (p95 < 500ms, error < 1%). Smoke → Load → Stress → Spike → Soak tests
options.C: Performance test chỉ khi bị complaint

questions.explanation: k6 test types: Smoke (minimal load, sanity check), Load (expected + peak load), Stress (beyond capacity, find breaking point), Spike (sudden traffic spikes), Soak (sustained load, memory leaks). k6 script: import http from 'k6/http'; export const options = { stages: [{duration:'2m', target:100}, {duration:'5m', target:100}, {duration:'2m', target:0}], thresholds: {'http_req_duration': ['p(95)<500'], 'http_req_failed': ['rate<0.01']} }; export default function() { http.get('https://api.example.com/products'); }. CI integration: k6 cloud hoặc run in CI, fail pipeline nếu thresholds exceeded.
